headline: THE BIRTH OF AN AI-NATIVE WORLD
subheadline: Two worlds. Different foundations. Connected futures.

workingManifesto.pt: No início, fez-se a luz. Na nossa Genesis, fez-se a ligação. E da ligação nasceu um novo mundo.
workingManifesto.en: In the beginning, there was light. In our Genesis, there was connection. And from connection, a new world was born.
workingManifesto.editorialNote: Creative working copy — subject to final editorial and brand approval.

acts.title: The Void
acts.visualSummary: Darkness, stillness and the first point of golden origin light awakening in the void.
acts.narrativeCaption: Before structure, there is intention — a single point of origin in the quiet void.

acts.title: The First Light
acts.visualSummary: Controlled cosmic expansion as stars, nebulae and luminous filaments form across deep space.
acts.narrativeCaption: Light expands into cosmic order — matter, gravity and the first constellations.

acts.title: Life
acts.visualSummary: Camera approaches Earth: atmosphere, oceans, organic ecosystems, human cities and biological intelligence.
acts.narrativeCaption: In the natural universe, life, society and human purpose emerge on a living planet.

acts.title: Digital Genesis
acts.visualSummary: Matter and signals translate into code, structured information, neural lattices and digital networks.
acts.narrativeCaption: A second foundation takes shape — built from information, code, context and networks.

acts.title: The World
acts.visualSummary: THE PULSE crosses the horizon as digital structures, capability constellations and six territories emerge.
acts.narrativeCaption: THE PULSE ignites: human governance and digital capability organize into a living ecosystem.

acts.title: GoWorld
acts.visualSummary: Natural and digital worlds align across the golden-cyan bridge as the camera enters the navigable GWD Universe.
acts.narrativeCaption: HELLO, WORLD. GO WORLD. Two worlds. Different foundations. Connected futures.

pulseModel.disclaimer: THE PULSE visualizations in this public release are deterministic simulations of organizational signaling, not live GWD Ops Core telemetry.

states.label: 01 · Dormant
states.description: Low-intensity ambient golden/cyan equilibrium across the core and territory rings.

states.label: 02 · Initiated
states.description: Origin signal ignites at a governance gate, mission trigger or knowledge node.

states.label: 03 · Transmitting
states.description: Luminous energy packet travels along typed organizational or knowledge pathways.

states.label: 04 · Connected
states.description: Source and destination nodes synchronize and illuminate their shared capability links.

states.label: 05 · Completed
states.description: Destination stabilizes, logs provenance and returns to balanced readiness.

events.summary: Simulates mandatory human authorization unlocking a legal, financial or launch stage gate.

events.summary: Simulates curated context retrieved from Knowledge Hub / Obsidian Vault into operational working memory.

events.summary: Simulates a validated Lab prototype advancing toward Venture Studio stage-gate review.

territories.name: THE GENESIS CORE
territories.overview: Origin light, institutional purpose, foundational principles, human governance and executive coordination architecture.

naturalParallel.title: Cosmic Origin & Human Purpose
naturalParallel.description: Gravity, foundational physical laws, ethical philosophy and human institutional stewardship that give direction to society.

digitalArchitecture.title: Governance & Executive Core
digitalArchitecture.description: Board of Administration, Advisory / Strategic Council, CEO & Executive Direction and the proposed AI Operations / Ops Core coordination architecture.

convergencePrinciple.title: Human Purpose Directs Agentic Scale
convergencePrinciple.description: Humans define purpose, ethics, risk appetite and irreversible decisions; digital systems execute within transparent, auditable boundaries.

territories.name: THE INTELLIGENCE
territories.overview: 18 catalogued capability divisions (283 upstream source profiles), People & Agent Operations, GBrain, Knowledge Hub, Obsidian Vaults and Knowledge Graph.

naturalParallel.title: Brain, Synapses & Human Memory
naturalParallel.description: Biological neural networks, short-term working focus, long-term semantic memory and specialized human expertise.

digitalArchitecture.title: Capability Catalogue, GBrain & Knowledge Galaxy
digitalArchitecture.description: 283 source profiles across 18 divisions, governed by People & Agent Operations and connected to GBrain, Knowledge Hub, Obsidian Vault documentation and contextual retrieval.

convergencePrinciple.title: Curated Context Without False Consciousness
convergencePrinciple.description: Agents do not possess biological consciousness; their effectiveness comes from human-curated instructions, governed memory and structured knowledge graphs.

territories.name: THE INFRASTRUCTURE
territories.overview: The Digital Fabric: transversal shared services, software platforms, APIs, cybersecurity, legal compliance and quality verification.

naturalParallel.title: Cities, Power Grids & Nervous Pathways
naturalParallel.description: Physical infrastructure, transport arteries, legal codes and civic utilities that sustain modern civilization.

digitalArchitecture.title: Layer 3 Shared Services & Platform Engineering
digitalArchitecture.description: AI Platform & Engineering, Security & Data Governance, Legal Risk & Compliance, Product & Innovation, Marketing & Comms, Finance & Admin and Strategy & Intelligence.

convergencePrinciple.title: Resilient Systems Under Human Assurance
convergencePrinciple.description: Shared technical and legal infrastructure ensures every business unit and agent workflow operates with security, privacy and cost discipline.

territories.name: THE ECONOMY
territories.overview: Layer 4 Business Units, cost/profit/investment-centre classifications and the deterministic Business Architecture Simulator.

naturalParallel.title: Markets, Trade & Value Creation
naturalParallel.description: Human enterprises, education, media, commerce and capital allocation that transform capability into societal value.

digitalArchitecture.title: Business Units & Deterministic Unit Economics
digitalArchitecture.description: GWD Academy, GWD Media Factory & Growth, GWD Sales & Customer Operations and GWD Ventures & Venture Studio, modelled with transparent cost/margin formulas.

convergencePrinciple.title: Transparent Unit Economics & Accountable Delivery
convergencePrinciple.description: AI-amplified delivery is measured against explicit shared-service allocations, direct costs and human commercial accountability.

territories.name: THE FRONTIER
territories.overview: Layer 5 Research Labs (5 documented Labs) and Venture Studio operating across a 6-stage maturity pipeline from Hypothesis to Venture Proposal.

naturalParallel.title: Scientific Discovery & Exploration
naturalParallel.description: Observatories, laboratories and scientific hypotheses pushing the boundaries of human understanding.

digitalArchitecture.title: Five Proposed Research Labs & Stage-Gated Venture Pipeline
digitalArchitecture.description: AI Research & Systems Lab, Agentic Architecture Lab, Data & Knowledge Lab, Human-AI Interaction Lab and Venture Experimentation Lab feeding GWD Ventures.

convergencePrinciple.title: Disciplined Experimentation Before Scale
convergencePrinciple.description: Every research hypothesis and agentic prototype passes through human-governed validation gates before becoming a venture candidate.

territories.name: THE CONVERGENCE
territories.overview: Human leadership and AI capability collaborating across multi-stage missions with mandatory Human Approval Gates across strategy, legal, financial, security, client and launch decisions.

naturalParallel.title: Collective Intelligence & Creative Teams
naturalParallel.description: Human judgment, empathy, ethics and creative leadership uniting diverse specialists around a shared mission.

digitalArchitecture.title: Supervised Multi-Unit Mission Workflows
digitalArchitecture.description: 3 deterministic mission scenarios mobilizing Business Units, Shared Services and candidate capability divisions under 14 mandatory Human Approval Gates.

convergencePrinciple.title: The Third Dimension: Human Direction + AI Amplification
convergencePrinciple.description: Neither isolated automation nor unassisted manual work: humans hold authority at every gate while digital workers accelerate research, synthesis and execution.
